name: – Lucia Yar – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Union Solidarity Fund to provide assistance to Malta and Italy regarding the storm Harry in January 2026 and to Portugal and Spain following the storms in January and February 2026
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving money from the European Union Solidarity Fund to four countries hit by storms in early 2026. Malta gets 3.7 million euros, Italy 74.9 million, Portugal 261.5 million and Spain 149.1 million — about 489 million euros in total. The fund helps countries recover from major natural disasters. The Parliament also asks the Commission to pay the money quickly, cut paperwork, and put more into preventing and preparing for disasters, especially on islands.

- **What changes:** About 489 million euros is released to Malta, Italy, Portugal and Spain for storm recovery.
- **Who it affects:** People, businesses and local authorities in the storm-hit regions of these four countries.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament and Council leaders sign the decision, and the Commission pays out, with some money already paid in advance.
